items.title: Russia's own figures show it has lost nearly 500,000 people in Ukraine war
items.description: Leaked data reveal how the full-scale invasion of Ukraine has fundamentally changed mortality patterns in Russia.

items.title: My family were killed in Ukraine. My mum blamed Zelensky's troops - the truth is complicated
items.description: BBC journalist Anastasiya Gribanova investigates who killed her father and grandparents in the war.

items.title: US stocks fall further as fears over AI intensify
items.description: All three main US indexes were down in early trading, with the tech-dominated Nasdaq down almost 4%.

items.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
items.description: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

items.title: Israeli strike kills senior Hamas security official and family in Gaza City
items.description: Mohammed Abu al-Ouf, head of Hamas's internal security service in northern Gaza, was killed with his wife and two teenage daughters, doctors say.

items.title: Five Russian military jets hit in airfield strike, says Ukraine
items.description: The Savasleyka airfield hosts aircraft used by Russia to launch hypersonic missiles and glide bombs at Ukraine.

items.title: Protesters call on Israel to free Palestinian student held without charge
items.description: Mahdi Tunsi, 26, was taken from his university dormitory earlier this month and has since been held without charge.

items.title: Colombian police storm supermarket to free 20 held hostage for 17 hours
items.description: One gunman was killed in the operation to free around 20 shoppers and employees after a 17-hour hostage ordeal.

items.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing US trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
items.description: The verdict follows a months-long trial in New York.

items.title: Canadian astronaut welcomes baby girl  from space station
items.description: Joshua Kutryk, currently on his first space mission, is just the fourth astronaut in history to miss the birth of a child while aboard the International Space Station.

items.title: Thomas Markle charged in US for possessing child sex abuse images
items.description: The FBI arrested Markle on 6 November after a search of a storage unit he had allegedly rented in Los Angeles uncovered the abuse material.

items.title: Two children among six dead after plane crash off Mississippi coast
items.description: Divers found the bodies of four adults and two boys, aged 8 and 10, in the fuselage, the US Coast Guard said.

claude-code.name: stringless
claude-code.description: Make your UI speak for itself. A skill for Claude Code and other coding agents that designs controls with no text labels: a note burns to delete, wet ink dries to save, glass frosts to go private.

claude-code.name: humanize-writing-skill
claude-code.description: Claude Code skill that makes Claude's prose read as written by a person. Rules on claims, sentence shape, and endings from 2026 research, tested blind on Haiku, Sonnet, and Opus. Applies while Claude writes. Does not change AI-detector scores.

claude-code.name: TokenSaver
claude-code.description: Cut your Claude Code token bill ~23% without changing how you work. A local proxy that trims what Claude Code resends. No AI model or API key needed.

claude-code.name: myco-notes
claude-code.description: Myco Notes: linked, versioned, secret-free project notes for you and your AI agents. Method, starter tree, tools and an agent skill (Claude Code, Codex, others).

claude-code.name: gilla-vr-windows-port
claude-code.description: Unofficial GILLA VR Windows PCVR port. Fan project - reverse engineered with Claude Code + Codex. Original game: free on Meta Quest.

vscode.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
